title: PowerToys shortcut editors flash the shortcut when holding the shortcut for the module activation (not inluding PowerToys keyboard manager module)
summary: Holding a shortcut in the Settings editor makes its preview flash.

judgment.rationale: The report gives an actionable scenario, but current behavior and the failing boundary are unverified.
evidence: On 0.95.1 the reporter describes opening an activation shortcut editor and holding the keys before saving, causing the preview to flash.
The report includes a video and identifies an ARM64 Windows machine; Keyboard Manager remapping is excluded.
Inspected src/settings-ui/Settings.UI/SettingsXAML/Controls/ShortcutControl/ShortcutControl.xaml.cs: keydown updates the internal settings and compares the new key list before updating the display.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce on a current build and identify the first failing stage before choosing a targeted correction.

fix_assessment.rationale: A targeted correction may be applicable after current behavior and its boundary are confirmed.

proposed_fixes.title: Investigate shortcut editor flashing on key repeat
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Repeated key events or visual refresh may cause the observed flashing, but the current guard and actual trigger require comparison.
plan: Reproduce held shortcut input on a current build and compare with normal press and release.
Trace repeated key events, shortcut state and visual refresh; account for existing same-value checks.
Correct the demonstrated unnecessary visual update without losing valid key changes or accessibility behavior.
Add focused regression coverage for repeated keydown, changing modifiers and key release.
verification: Holding a shortcut leaves a stable preview and saving captures the intended combination.
Changing or releasing keys and accessible keyboard navigation still work.

confidence.rationale: The reported scenario is concrete but the current-build behavior and failing stage remain unknown.

reproduce.title: Investigate shortcut editor flashing on key repeat
reproduce.version_requirement: Use the current PowerToys release and compare the reported version if practical.
prerequisites: Use a Windows test environment and preserve the original configuration.
setup: Open Settings and an activation shortcut editor for a module other than Keyboard Manager.
steps: 1. Press and hold a valid activation shortcut without saving.
2. Observe the preview for repeated flashing, then release the keys.
3. Change one modifier and save; verify the saved shortcut.
4. Compare ARM64 and x64 if available and inspect repeated key events and visual updates.
reproduce.expected_result: The shortcut preview remains stable while held and accurately reflects valid changes.
